title: स्थापना दिवस (STHAPANA DIVAS) 2023
description: Fifteen years ago, in 2008, IIT Gandhinagar embarked on its journey with humble beginnings, admitting its first batch of BTech students to the temporary campus at Vishwakarma Government Engineering College, Chandkheda. Since then, we have grown by leaps and bounds, and today, we proudly stand with a vibrant student community of over 2200. In 2015, we took a significant step forward by relocating to our sprawling and picturesque campus spread across 400 acres on the banks of the beautiful river Sabarmati.
